hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

yuLXJ8H3-kvzJjJ26Or4aw.en: Nigeria's epidemic shows a downward trend: 12 confirmed cases were reported in week 36, fewer than the 18 in week 35. Cumulatively this year through week 36, 1,086 confirmed cases and 259 deaths have been reported (case fatality rate 23.9%, higher than 18.6% in the same period last year), spread across 24 states (118 local government areas). 87% of cases are concentrated in five states – Bauchi, Ondo, Taraba, Benue and Edo – and patients are mainly aged 21–30. Authorities urge continued vigilance against transmission risk from rodents.

iTifhSV3YPdPp3P4VQcmgg.zh: 非洲地區疫情持續,WHO今年9/16發佈風險評估報告,該地區風險評估為中等(Moderate)、全球風險低(Low)。今年截至8月下旬,該洲共8國出現疫情,累計逾1.5萬例疑病例,以奈及利亞12,155例疑病例、225例死亡為主,其次為查德(1,251例疑病例、5例死亡)、日(818例疑病例、27例死亡)及幾內亞(600例確定病例、49例死亡)等。疫苗覆蓋率下降、低實驗室確診率、即時治療(抗生素及白喉抗毒素)的不穩定性,人群跨境移動等因素阻礙疫情控制。
iTifhSV3YPdPp3P4VQcmgg.en: Diphtheria activity continues in Africa. WHO issued a risk assessment on 16 September: the regional risk is assessed as moderate and the global risk as low. As of late August this year, eight countries in the region have reported outbreaks, with more than 15,000 cumulative suspected cases, mainly Nigeria with 12,155 suspected cases and 225 deaths, followed by Chad (1,251 suspected cases, 5 deaths), Niger (818 suspected cases, 27 deaths) and Guinea (600 confirmed cases, 49 deaths). Declining vaccine coverage, low laboratory confirmation rates, unstable access to immediate treatment (antibiotics and diphtheria antitoxin) and cross-border population movement are hindering outbreak control.

j_x2zPRkh8cOf741DvK8rA.zh: 塞內加爾疫情持續,今年截至9/8累計報告57例確定病例,其中8例死亡(致死率:14%),分布於8(/14)個行政區,並以凱杜古區(Kédougou Region)27例為多,當局呼籲家⻑應確認孩童接種情形,並依免疫接種規劃期程進行疫苗接種,且於出現症狀時即時就醫。 奈及利亞今年截至9/12已累計超過1萬例病例,98%確定病例分佈於8個州,其中68%確定病例未接種疫苗,推估持續的免疫缺口,導致疫情持續不斷。另高原州(Plateau State)疫情擴大,今年8/24-30報告48例確定病例,其中4例死亡,9/7起暫時關閉所有中/小學校,以降低傳播風險,並加強疾病監測、接觸者追蹤及疫苗接種等防治措施。
j_x2zPRkh8cOf741DvK8rA.en: Diphtheria in Senegal continues. As of 8 September this year, 57 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, 8 of whom died (case fatality rate 14%), spread across 8 of 14 districts, with 27 cases in Kédougou Region. Authorities urge parents to check children's vaccination status, to vaccinate according to the immunisation schedule, and to seek medical care promptly when symptoms appear. In Nigeria, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported this year as of 12 September; 98% of confirmed cases are distributed across 8 states, and 68% of confirmed cases were unvaccinated, indicating persistent immunity gaps that keep the outbreak going. The outbreak has also expanded in Plateau State, which reported 48 confirmed cases during 24–30 August this year, 4 of them fatal; from 7 September, all primary and secondary schools were temporarily closed to reduce the risk of transmission, and surveillance, contact tracing and vaccination are being strengthened.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

In environmental samples, WPV1 added 15 detections in two countries: 10 in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV1 added 1 detection in South Sudan; cVDPV2 added 5 detections in three countries: 3 in Somalia, and 1 each in Libya and Nigeria; and cVDPV3 added 1 detection in Nigeria.

KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.

1Z2fb5rM9WigOSxR6I4ctg.zh: 奈及利亞疫情持續升溫,今年截至第30週累計報告1,000例確定病例與237例死亡(CFR 23.7%,高於去年同期18.8%),波及23州116個區,病患以21-30歲族群為主。另今年累計53名醫療人員確診,顯示醫療機構感染管制不佳,當局在WHO及US CDC支持下,已啟動為期30天的緊急防護計畫。NCDC表示個案數與致死率上升主因為治療費用高昂、延遲就醫及環境衛生不佳等影響。
1Z2fb5rM9WigOSxR6I4ctg.en: Nigeria's epidemic continues to escalate: as of week 30 this year, 1,000 confirmed cases and 237 deaths have been reported cumulatively (CFR 23.7%, higher than 18.8% for the same period last year), spread across 23 states and 116 local government areas, with patients mainly aged 21–30. In addition, 53 healthcare workers have been confirmed infected this year, indicating poor infection control in healthcare facilities. With support from WHO and US CDC, authorities have launched a 30-day emergency protection plan. The NCDC states that the main reasons for the rise in cases and case fatality are high treatment costs, delayed care-seeking and poor environmental sanitation.

p0e43Mm6Hwq3wrT-LW85IQ.zh: 奈及利亞疫情升溫,截至今年第28週累計報告963例確定病例與229例死亡(CFR 23.8%,高於去年同期18.7%),波及23州114個區,86%病例集中於包奇州(Bauchi)、翁多州(Ondo)、塔拉巴州(Taraba)、貝努埃州(Benue)、埃多州(Edo)這5州。病患以21至30 歲族群為主,推估因從事農業、市場貿易等職業面臨較高的嚙齒動物及汙染環境暴露風險;另於28週新增1名醫療人員確診,凸顯臨床存在感染管制漏洞。
p0e43Mm6Hwq3wrT-LW85IQ.en: Lassa fever is rising in Nigeria. As of week 28 this year, 963 confirmed cases and 229 deaths have been reported cumulatively (CFR 23.8%, higher than 18.7% in the same period last year). Cases have spread to 114 districts in 23 states, and 86% of cases are concentrated in five states: Bauchi, Ondo, Taraba, Benue and Edo. Most patients are aged 21 to 30 years. Because of occupations such as farming and market trading, they are estimated to face higher exposure risk from rodents and contaminated environments. In addition, one healthcare worker was newly confirmed in week 28, highlighting gaps in clinical infection control.

nZmNDVjhfXU3yvgCKk10lA.zh: 奈及利亞去年累計報告1萬5,273例確定病例,相較前年1萬714 例確定病例,增加42.5%。近期日(Niger State )出現疑白喉群聚事件,截至7/18,有2名兒童住院治療,1名死亡,針對本次事件,該國與聯合國兒童基金會(UNICEF)已緊急介入,加強當地感染預防與控制(IPC)及加強個案管理,以防止疫情擴散。
nZmNDVjhfXU3yvgCKk10lA.en: Nigeria reported 15,273 confirmed cases last year, an increase of 42.5% over the 10,714 confirmed cases the year before. Recently, a suspected diphtheria cluster emerged in Niger State. As of 18 July, 2 children had been hospitalized and 1 death had occurred. In response, Nigeria and UNICEF have intervened urgently to strengthen local infection prevention and control (IPC) and case management, in order to prevent further spread.

1aj39QTFtTX64mDXg7ZQVw.zh: 奈及利亞疫情升溫,已波及全國23州(23/36),其中85%病例集中於5個州(翁多州Ondo 30%、包奇州Bauchi 26%、塔拉巴州Taraba 14%、埃多州Edo 9%及貝努埃州Benue 6%)。今年累計報告922例確定病例,其中221例死亡,致死率24%,高於去(2025)年同期(790例,其中190例死亡),21至30歲為主要受影響族群。當局已於2019年1月宣布此波疫情為國家級公共衛生緊急事件。
1aj39QTFtTX64mDXg7ZQVw.en: Lassa fever is rising in Nigeria, which has now affected 23 of the country's 36 states. Of cases, 85% are concentrated in 5 states: Ondo (30%), Bauchi (26%), Taraba (14%), Edo (9%) and Benue (6%). This year, 922 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 221 deaths, a CFR of 24%. This is higher than the same period last year (790 cases, including 190 deaths). Patients aged 21 to 30 years are the main affected group. In January 2019, authorities declared this wave of the outbreak a national public health emergency.

In the DRC, an outbreak in Kwango Province began at the end of June, with a case fatality ratio of 7.4%, above WHO's alert threshold of 1%. The country's most recent human case occurred in 1972.

WHO noted that weekly new cases in the region are generally declining and most countries have activated response operations, but shortages of diagnostic tests, laboratory capacity and drugs persist. WHO has therefore revised the overall public health risk for the African Region from 'high' to 'moderate'. Most countries outside Africa have robust immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is assessed as 'low'; however, the risk of disease for travellers to the African Region should still be noted.

jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.

Ry_nHw8QL-LR7aLPoygsHQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/5-12/11期間,巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德2例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增15件WPV1陽性樣本;共5國新增11件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為巴勒斯坦6件、吉布地2件、阿爾及利亞/象牙海岸/日各1件。 歐洲更新cVDPV2陽性樣本資訊,英國於12/10發布於倫敦、南部及中部地區檢出4件陽性樣本,德國新增6件陽性樣本,所有樣本皆於11月採集;歐洲迄今累計5國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,經檢驗該地區樣本皆與奈及利亞贊法拉州(Zamfara)病毒株相關,ECDC表示病毒可能由流行地區多次移入或一次移入後於歐洲社區傳播。

Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: five in Nigeria and two in Chad. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 15 new WPV1-positive samples. Five countries reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples: six in Palestine, two in Djibouti, and one each in Algeria, Côte d'Ivoire and Niger. Europe has updated its cVDPV2-positive sample information: the United Kingdom reported on 10 December that four positive samples had been detected in London and in the southern and central regions, and Germany reported six new positive samples; all samples were collected in November. So far, five European countries have detected cVDPV2-positive samples. Testing shows that the samples in this region are all related to the virus strain from Zamfara State, Nigeria. ECDC says the virus may have been introduced to Europe through repeated introductions from endemic areas, or through a single introduction followed by community spread.

_CgJVUxeyQWRajS0RzYCuA.en: In Kaduna State in northern Nigeria, an unidentified outbreak occurred at a military school in early December. Media reports say several students have been hospitalised and at least two have died; the cause of death of the first fatal case was a cardiovascular condition.

79E2RhAsSkAeiw7tVdBtbA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/21-11/27期間,巴基斯坦新增6例WPV1病例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增24件WPV1陽性樣本;共2國新增2件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為阿爾及利亞/奈及利亞各1件。GPEI 11/28 德國11/28公布分別於4座城市汙水中皆檢出cVDPV2,歐洲近期分別於波蘭及西班牙相繼檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,惟目前尚未發現任何病例。WHO及ECDC皆表示各國都應持續留意,並進行常規監測和疫苗接種,以防止病毒在社區中重新傳播。
79E2RhAsSkAeiw7tVdBtbA.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 21 and 27 November, Pakistan added 6 WPV1 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 24 WPV1-positive samples. In total, 2 countries added 2 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Algeria and Nigeria (GPEI, 28 November).

Germany announced on 28 November that cVDPV2 had been detected in wastewater in each of 4 cities.
